notes.title: Update 1.9.11 Fixes and Improvements and Settings Reset!
notes.notes:
Cyber Sentinel – Changelog 

v1.9.10 – Web Steam Fallback
Full API compatibility and offline achievement tracking via localStorage

Added onAchievementUnlocked() event system

Improved type safety and developer tools

Production-ready browser fallback for Steam

v1.9.9 – Greenworks Integration
Replaced steamworks.js with Greenworks

Full Steam API support (achievements, overlay, Steam ID)

Multi-platform support (Electron, Tauri, Web)

Includes TypeScript types and debug tools

v1.9.6 – XP Gem Sound
New sound for XP gem collection (collectdata.mp3)

Triggers for both player and drone pickups

Applies to all gem types with 70% base volume

v1.9.5 – Weapon Sounds
Added sounds for machine gun, shotgun, reload, and ammo pickup

Balanced volume (80–90% of base)

Enhances combat feedback

v1.9.4 – Ability Shortcuts
New keybinds: Z (Freeze), C (Burn), Shift+C (Flood), Shift+V (Virus)

Conflict-free and theme-consistent

v1.9.3 – Upgrade Menu Shortcut
V key now closes the Upgrade Menu (also ESC, S)

Improves accessibility and control

v1.9.2 – Achievements Finalized
Full implementation of 40 achievements

Includes test panel and debug tools

Ready for production deployment

v1.9.1 – Overload Fix
Effect now targets only visible enemies inside the red circle

Added bounds and visibility checks for fairness

v1.9.0 – Achievement System Init
Introduced Steam achievement tracking (40 total)

Auto fallback for offline mode

Includes debug shortcuts for testing

v1.8.2 – Settings UI Fix
Clear labels: "ENABLED"/"DISABLED" with color indicators

Resolved previous confusion with toggle states

v1.8.1 – Reroll Reset + Cost Display
Reroll penalty resets after 2 level-ups

Fixed upgrade menu to show accurate costs

v1.8.0 – Balance Update
Player base damage increased by 4.7%

SummonerEnemy nerfed: reduced minions, slower spawn, longer cooldown

Improved early and mid-game balance

notes.title: Small Patch: Better Localization + Balance Adjustments
notes.notes:
Thank you all for the support so far!

I’ve been testing the game a lot lately and even streaming some of it. Based on feedback and ongoing testing, I’ve started making more balance adjustments.



Here’s what’s new in this update:



Early game player damage has been increased slightly to improve pacing and challenge.

Small fixes have been made to some enemies and abilities.

The reroll penalty has been nerfed it now clears after two level-ups.

A shield has been added to the boss encounter, along with a slight bluff to make the boss feel a bit tankier overall.



Game localization has been improved across the board and will continue to be updated.

If you run into any issues or have suggestions, please let me know your feedback really helps me make the game better.

Thanks again for all the support! I’m truly happy to see so many of you enjoying the game. What matters most to me is improving it further and making sure it stays fun for everyone.



Hint:

You can change the game language in the settings!

P.S.: Japanese will be added in the next update hopefully by Monday if all goes well!
